reason: I already drop slides into ChatGPT or NotebookLM and share past-exam summaries in my Zalo study group for free, so in a normal week I wouldn't pay for a new cram site, especially when joining friends' Arena rooms and testing one PDF are free anyway.
objection: Even with an untimed toggle, 'Clutch Arena' still feels like a timed quiz app on top of AI math, and I don't trust a 60-second pack to match my lecturer's exact quant formulas or conventions when an exam is on the line.
would_change_my_mind: If I had a brutal quant exam in 48 hours and testing the free preview on our actual past paper nailed my professor's exact steps cleaner and faster than ChatGPT.
